verdict.rationale: Vue's official SSR API documents several streaming renderers in vue/server-renderer: Node.js Readable streams, Web ReadableStream, pipe-to-writable variants and renderToSimpleStream. These work in both Node and edge environments such as Cloudflare Workers. Vue 3.5+ also adds lazy hydration strategies that let async components hydrate on idle, on visibility or on interaction, which serves the 'reach interactivity faster' goal. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that streaming SSR works well in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can render my application on the server with streaming support to reach interactivity faster

citations.quote: It is also possible to stream rendering using the Node.js Stream API or Web Streams API.
renderToWebStream() "Renders input as a Web ReadableStream"
In Vue 3.5+, async components can control when they are hydrated by providing a hydration strategy. Vue provides a number of built-in hydration strategies.
